S.name: H1 BuBC+ / BuC2+ → 5m First BC
S.entry: Next 3 H1 candles: the FIRST 5m BC (close above the prior 5m high) while price is still above the BuC MP line (75%). No trade if a 5m candle closes below the BuC MD line (25%), if the MMCB Target trades first, or if the first BC comes below the BuC MP line.
S.exit: 1:2 RR (100 pts) · out at the close of the 10th H1 candle

S.name: Daily BuBC+ / BuC2+ → H4 Zone
S.entry: Next 3 days: wait for an H4 wick to the BuC MP line (75%) with no H4 close below it, then the first H4 candle closing up (NBC). An H4 close below the MP line moves the wait to the BuC BAL line (50%), below BAL to the BuC MD line (25%), below MD = no trade.
S.stop: Next line down (BAL for an MP entry, MD for BAL, the H4 candle PL for MD) · each new H4 BuBC+ / BuC2+ moves it up to its BuC BAL line
S.exit: MMCB Target · out at the close of the 10th day

S.name: H4 BuBC+ / BuC2+ Ladder Trend
S.entry: Buy the close of an H4 BuBC+ or BuC2+.
S.exit: Ladder line: starts at the candle BuC BAL line (50%), steps up to the BAL line of each new H4 BuBC+ / BuC2+. Out on the first H4 close below it, or after 30 H4 candles.

S.name: H1 BuBC+ / BuC2+ → 1m BC Reclaim
S.entry: Next 3 H1 candles: the FIRST 1m BC that also closes above the high of the last 1m BeBC (a reclaim), while no 1m candle closed below the BuC MD line (25%) and the MMCB Target has not traded.
S.exit: No target · out at the close of the 10th H1 candle (clock exit)

S.name: Daily BuBC+ / BuC2+ → H1 First NBC
S.entry: Next 3 days: the FIRST H1 candle closing up (NBC) while price is still above the BuC MP line (75%).
S.stop: The BuC MD line (25%, about 237 pts)
S.exit: MMCB Target · out at the close of the 10th day

S.name: H4 BuC2+ Close
S.bias: H4 BuC2+ (took the prior low, then closed above the prior high, close in the top 25%)
S.entry: Buy the close of the H4 BuC2+.
S.stop: The BuC MD line (25% of the candle)
S.exit: 1:2 RR · out at the close of the 10th H4 candle
S.robust: All 6 settings with the BuC MD line or PL stop (1:1, 1:2, 1:3) passed: the most solid of the new ones.

S.name: H4 BuBC− Close
S.bias: H4 BuBC− (closed above the prior high, close NOT in the top 25%)
S.entry: Buy the close of the H4 BuBC−.
S.exit: 1:2 RR (100 pts) · out at the close of the 10th H4 candle
S.robust: Works only with the 50 pt stop (1:1 and 1:2 pass). The BuC MD line and PL stops do not.

S.name: Daily BuAFs+ Close
S.bias: Daily BuAFs+ (took the prior day low only, closed back inside, close in the top half)
S.entry: Buy the close of the Daily BuAFs+.
S.stop: The BuC MD line (25% of the candle, about 177 pts)
S.exit: 1:2 RR · out at the close of the 10th day
S.robust: 1:1 and 1:2 pass with the BuC MD line stop. Only 83 trades and 5 in 2026: size small, watch it.
